🔥🇬🇦 A JACK-UP DRILLING RIG SANK OFF GABON AFTER LOSING STABILITY DURING POSITIONING OPERATIONS

Borr Drilling’s Prospector 5 suffered a “punch-through” before drilling had even begun, causing the rig to tilt and eventually go under near the Dussafu Marin area.

There were 115 people on board. Officials say 110 were accounted for, while 5 remain missing.

Production nearby was suspended as a precaution, and search teams are still working the area.
